description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git commands, specifically related to packing, object verification, and detecting missing or corrupted commit objects.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with setup or verification commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; the test passes if the command fails.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp to ensure unique commit times.
